nameEn: Retail sale of textiles in specialised stores
description: This class includes the retail sale of textiles in specialised stores.
includes: retail sale of fabrics, yarn, threads and sewing notions
retail sale of household textiles: bed linen, curtains, towels
retail sale of floor coverings (soft): carpets, rugs
retail sale of haberdashery: buttons, ribbons, hooks
retail sale of needlework kits and supplies
excludes: retail sale of carpets and hard floor coverings, see 4753
